items.headline: 伊朗核問題移送安理會
items.context: 國際原子能總署（IAEA）理事會通過決議，把伊朗因核不遵約問題移送聯合國安理會，美國、德國、法國和英國是這次升級動作的發起方。德黑蘭對決議表示譴責，說是美國和以色列先前對其核設施的攻擊，才讓查核工作中斷。
items.thread_text:
伊朗核問題移送安理會

國際原子能總署理事會投票通過，把伊朗的核不遵約問題正式移送聯合國安理會，發起這次升級的是美國、德國、法國和英國。

德黑蘭馬上反擊，說查核工作會中斷，全是因為美國和以色列先前空襲了伊朗的核設施——現在被究責，伊朗覺得自己才是受害者。

—— 本則來自 BBC、Al Jazeera，2026 年 9 月 10 日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
items.threads_text:
伊朗核問題移送安理會

國際原子能總署（IAEA）理事會通過決議，將伊朗的核不遵約問題正式移送聯合國安理會。這次升級動作由美國、德國、法國和英國共同發起，象徵國際社會對伊朗核查合作程度的不滿又往上升了一級。

德黑蘭隨即出面譴責這項決議，強調查核之所以中斷，責任在於美國與以色列先前對伊朗核設施發動的攻擊——伊朗把自己定位成受害的一方，而不是不配合查核的一方。

本則整理自 BBC 與 Al Jazeera 於 2026 年 9 月 10 日發佈的報導。

items.headline: 英以關係跌至數十年低點
items.context: 英國首相伯納姆（Andy Burnham）出面力挺一項貿易禁令——禁止英國與以色列在約旦河西岸屯墾區的貿易往來。以色列的反應相當強烈，讓英以關係跌到數十年來的最低點。
items.thread_text:
英以關係跌至數十年低點

英國首相伯納姆公開力挺一項貿易禁令：英國全面禁止與以色列在約旦河西岸屯墾區的貿易往來。

以色列的反彈相當激烈，這場外交拉鋸，讓英以關係跌到數十年來的最低點。

—— 本則來自 BBC、Al Jazeera，2026 年 9 月 10 日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
items.threads_text:
英以關係跌至數十年低點

英國首相伯納姆（Andy Burnham）出面為一項貿易禁令辯護：英國決定禁止與以色列在約旦河西岸屯墾區的一切貿易往來。這項政策，直接衝著以色列的屯墾政策而來。

以色列方面的反應相當強烈，讓這場外交摩擦，把英以關係推到數十年來的最低點——雙邊關係的緊張程度，已經不是外交辭令能輕鬆帶過的層級。

本則整理自 BBC 與 Al Jazeera 於 2026 年 9 月 10 日發佈的報導。
items.voice_text: 英國和以色列的關係，跌到了數十年來的最低點。導火線是英國首相伯納姆力挺的一項禁令——禁止英國和以色列在約旦河西岸屯墾區做生意。以色列的反彈很激烈，兩邊的外交氣氛，明顯降到冰點。

sources.summary: In HBO’s gripping new docuseries A Killer Story, a crusading couple become convinced that woman accused of murder is innocent A man and a woman are murdered in cold blood inside their Topeka, Kansas, bedroom under cover of darkness in 2002. Suspicion quickly falls on the man’s ex-wife, Dana Chandler, with family and forensic evidence painting her as the jealous type. But the county prosecutor at the time declines to pursue charges in large part because nothing places Chandler at the scene of the crime. It’s only after a politically motivated prosecutor is appointed and CBS’s 48 Hours airs a 2009 report rehashing the case that Chandler is arrested on two counts of premeditated first-degree murder in 2011 and condemned to consecutive life sentences the following year. No doubt: the story is hot copy. And more than likely, Chandler’s conviction marks the conclusion if a husband-and-wife team of true crime enthusiasts hadn’t become convinced that the real killer was still walking free. “There’s a lot of questions that remain,” says film-maker Matthew Galkin. “But when you start to unpack the crime itself, there’s a lot of hoops to jump through and a very high bar to clear in order for her to have pulled this off.” Continue reading...

sources.summary: From Naomi Osaka’s NBA-inspired entrance to Dennis Rodman’s punk aesthetic, Black sportspeople have long used fashion to express identity, defiance and joy When Long Wave lead writer Nesrine Malik asked me if I’d seen Japanese-Haitian tennis star Naomi Osaka’s incredible pre-match look, I began to wax lyrical about the kimono she donned at Wimbledon a couple of months ago. No, not that look – Nesrine was talking about the NBA-inspired hoodie she wore at the US Open, taking to the court head bowed and hands in pockets, with the theatre of a WWE wrestler. By the time I sat down to write, Osaka had worn another viral walk-on outfit. The star isn’t the first to acquire as many headlines for her clothes as for her performance. Osaka draws on a long tradition of Black athletes giving crowds their money’s worth through playful and provocative fashion statements. I delved into the history of why so many Black communities have a culture of “presenting”, and how defiance through fashion has found a natural home in sport. Continue reading...

攝影與雲端遊戲二三事

先看攝影。攝影師徐傑瑞（Jerry Hsu）分享他的代表作：2011或2012年，他在洛杉磯街頭看到黑煙從下水道的柵欄竄出，畫面戲劇性十足，像有什麼東西要從地底冒出來。

sources.summary: ‘The black cloud emerged from a grate in the street. I guess something underground was on fire. It was hilariously cinematic – just one of those eerie, spontaneous things that happen in a city’ This image was taken in 2011 or 2012, just after I had moved to Los Angeles. I was downtown, an area I don’t go to that much, walking around with my camera. Some black smoke started to emerge from a grate in the street – I guess something underground was on fire. It was hilariously cinematic, as if some sort of devil was going to appear. It was really just one of those eerie, spontaneous things that happen in a city. There is a very powerful feeling of surrender when I am photographing. I have to submit to the authority of ignorance when I’m out there. I grew up in San Jose, which is a sprawling American suburb – there’s no city about it. I came to LA because I was depressed where I lived, and I had just met my future wife, who didn’t want to live in San Jose either. LA is not really a city, it’s hundreds of places. You can drive 15 minutes and be in a completely different environment – the beach, the mountains. There’s a weird sentience to the city, if you let it take you. I get an inexplicable desire to just get in the car and go. Continue reading...

sources.summary: Once hailed as the future, even the likes of Google, Sony and Microsoft have struggled to make streaming games fun, fast or affordable • Don’t get Pushing Buttons delivered to your inbox? Sign up here In August 2009, at the very first Gamescom expo, I sat in a small meeting room in Germany and played Mario Kart and World of Warcraft on a laptop, via technology that was then completely new: cloud gaming. It was a demonstration for a yet-to-be-launched service called Gaikai that promised to let you play any game in a browser window, without a console. (Here is an ancient video of that demonstration, featuring a very young Keza.) With a single click I could launch into any game, hosted on servers hundreds of miles away. It really did look like the future. Since then, plenty of companies have tried to be the first to truly crack game streaming, vying to be the Netflix of games. Sony ended up buying Gaikai for $380m (£242m) in 2012; its technology now powers the streamable classic games library on PlayStation, and the PS5’s advanced game streaming. OnLive, Gaikai’s first competitor, launched in 2011 but shut down after less than a year, leaving Sony to acquire all its patents. Google’s Stadia cloud gaming service also imploded, launching in 2019 and shutting down three years later. Continue reading...

目前這則消息只有單一來源，細節有限。

布蘭特原油價格漲破每桶100美元，是自七月以來首見——一天之內就漲了超過3%，衝上101美元。

導火線是美國與伊朗在波斯灣的最新一輪交火，加上青年運動（Houthi）武裝對沙烏地阿拉伯城市發動的攻擊。分析師預期，油價偏高的狀況今年剩下的時間都會持續。

—— 本則來自 The New York Times、The Guardian，2026 年 9 月 10 日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
items.threads_text:
油價衝破百元大關

國際油價指標布蘭特原油，漲破每桶100美元，是自七月以來首次見到這個價位。一天之內漲幅超過3%，最高衝上101美元以上，全球原油供應鏈的緊張情緒明顯升溫。

這波漲勢的導火線，是美國與伊朗在波斯灣爆發最新一輪的交火，加上青年運動（Houthi）武裝對沙烏地阿拉伯多座城市發動攻擊——中東的緊張情勢持續威脅全球石油供應。分析師預期，油價偏高的狀況，會一路延續到今年年底。

本則整理自 The New York Times 與 The Guardian 於 2026 年 9 月 10 日發佈的報導。
